exposure: Reduced fetal growth (percentile decrease in estimated weight between 35 weeks gestation and birth)
outcome: Adverse perinatal outcomes (APOs) including cesarean or instrumental delivery for nonreassuring fetal status
cohort: A cohort of 9,164 non-small for gestational age fetuses initially estimated by ultrasound at 35 weeks of gestation.
finding: Fetuses exhibiting reduced estimated percentile weight (EPW) between 35 weeks of gestation and birth have a higher risk of adverse perinatal outcomes (APOs), with the risk doubling for those with a decrease exceeding 40 percentile points.
mod_finding: Adverse perinatal outcomes included cesarean or instrumental delivery for nonreassuring fetal status.
gest_age: Initial assessment at 35 weeks gestation; median gestational age at delivery was around 40 weeks.
